title: School Trip to Windfield
passage: School Trip to Windfield. Notice: Breakfast in the hotel restaurant between 7 and 9 a.m. We leave at 9 a.m. sharp every day. 1. Learning about art: how to draw and make pots. 2. If you don't eat meat, you must tell Mr. Jones by Wednesday night at the latest. 3. Remember to bring your own water. If you forget, you will be very thirsty. 4. Prizes will be given to game winners. 5. The trip to Candy Island will happen if the weather is dry. If it's raining heavily, we will go to an indoor swimming pool. Please bring swimming caps. We have some but cannot lend them to everyone. 6. Free time between 1 p.m. and 6 p.m. Students are advised to use this time to pack.
